exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal, elective cesarean, emergency cesarean)
outcome: Depression (measured by Edinburgh Postnatal Depression Scale)
cohort: 2,234 Italian women who delivered healthy term neonates
finding: While overall postpartum depressive symptoms were similar between groups, women who underwent elective cesarean delivery had higher anxiety scores, and women who underwent emergency cesarean delivery had higher anhedonia scores.
mod_finding: Women who underwent elective cesarean delivery had higher anxiety scores, and those who underwent emergency cesarean delivery had higher anhedonia scores.
